title: Mean of the Bool-to-$\pm 1$ embedding vanishes
statement:
Under the embedding $\mathrm{BoolToPM1} : \mathrm{Bool} \to \bbr$ that sends $\mathtt{false}$ to $1$ and $\mathtt{true}$ to $-1$, the average of its two values is zero:
\[
  \frac{\mathrm{BoolToPM1}(\mathtt{false}) + \mathrm{BoolToPM1}(\mathtt{true})}{2} = 0.
\]
replaced:
The average of the two values of the $\pm 1$ embedding is zero:
\[
  \frac{\mathrm{BoolToPM1}(\mathtt{false}) + \mathrm{BoolToPM1}(\mathtt{true})}{2} = 0.
\]
